subject.title: [Feishu] "This reply completed without visible content" fallback incorrectly triggered for long/markdown-heavy replies (regression from #87896)

question: Is the issue's session-level telemetry enough to promote a repair now, or should maintainers require a live Feishu/trajectory reproduction that shows where the long markdown final disappears before coding?
rationale: The reported user impact is credible, but current source inspection does not identify whether the root cause is final extraction, Feishu delivery/card rendering, streaming close, or dispatch count reconciliation.

options.title: Require live or trajectory proof first
options.body: Ask for a redacted Feishu transcript/log or run a live reproduction that shows the assistant final, delivery attempts, count reconciliation, and fallback trigger before promoting a fix.

options.title: Allow a guarded source investigation
options.body: Let a repair worker add a focused regression harness only if it first reproduces the zero-final long-markdown path without broad fallback-policy changes.

recommendation.title: Require live or trajectory proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Feishu transcript/log or run a live reproduction that shows the assistant final, delivery attempts, count reconciliation, and fallback trigger before promoting a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the heaviest adjacent work on Feishu fallback edge cases and failed visible final handling inside the merged fallback PR.
